LONG DISTANCE / TUNNEL

AD-400 Tunnel Inspection ROV

Built around the demands of the long run.

A specialist platform for long-distance inspection of flooded water tunnels, combining a tethered vehicle with project-specific sensing and tether management.

Read the application guide

Configuration checks

  • Review tunnel geometry, bends, elevation profile and obstacles.
  • Confirm flow limits, tether drag and retrieval arrangements.
  • Agree position referencing and acceptance criteria before the mission.

COMPLETE SYSTEM

Specify more than
the vehicle.

The official website states a maximum operation distance of 5 km; the supplied brochure lists 5.5 km. The deliverable range must be confirmed against the supplied version and project conditions.

Confirm in the delivered scope

  • Vehicle and installed payload
  • Control station and software functions
  • Tether length, reel and power supply
  • Selected tools, sensors and deployment equipment
  • Transport cases, spares, manuals and training

Standard, optional and custom items must be listed separately in the quotation.
